description: Return the FlareWatch agent's recent action feed: surface, action kind (observation/propose/topup/rollback/claim/etc), outcome, and detect-to-remediate latency on the agent's own recoveries. Validator-surface entries are proposals only — the node's own controllers act, never the agent. Source: hourly signed snapshot, verifiable via chain_verify_url; available=false when it is unavailable.
name: get_recent_agent_actions
title: Get Recent Agent Actions
